name: Chabok | چابک
author: Tesmino

sections.description:
Chabok is a WordPress plugin developed by Tesmino that automates the process of publishing advertorials (reportages) directly from the Tesmino platform to WordPress.

Instead of manually uploading, formatting, and publishing content, Chabok handles it all automatically using Tesmino’s secure API. This saves time, reduces errors, and ensures every reportage is published exactly as scheduled.

Key Features

  • Automatic content publishing from Tesmino to WordPress
  • Secure API authentication with access token
  • Simple and user-friendly interface
  • Supports different content formats
  • Fully compatible with the latest WordPress versions

Plugin URI

https://tesmino.com/blog/chabok
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Chabok or Tesmino.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/chabok.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Chabok Tesmino and enter your API token.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API token?

You can generate your API token from your Tesmino publisher dashboard: https://next.tesmino.com/publisher/website/websites

Is this plugin free?

Yes. Chabok is 100% free to use.
